title: Storage Configuration
description: Optional storage.yaml in the config home. The entry point opens the configured database and passes its connection to Store. No environment-variable overrides; absence disables configured storage.

dsn.description: PostgreSQL or SQLite connection URI, passed unchanged to the connection-opening host. SQLite examples: sqlite:///:memory: or sqlite:////absolute/path/audit.db. This value may contain credentials; do not log it.
